# Shop Bubble Mailers

> Bulk and custom printed bubble mailers (padded shipping envelopes) for US businesses. Kraft and white poly, every standard size from 4x6 to #7 (14.25x20), sold by the case or pallet, plain or logo printed. Quotes returned by email within 1-2 hours. Every size can be ordered online (Add to order, minimum order 250 mailers, paid by PayPal invoice, bank transfer or cash on delivery after the digital proof). Based in Bloomington, Illinois; ships nationwide.

Contact: Info@shopbubblemailers.com · (503) 461-4788 · https://shopbubblemailers.com/contact-us/

## Key facts
- Sizes: inch sizes 4x6, 4x7, 6x9 (9x6), 7x9, 8.5x12, 10.5x15, 12x12, 12x15 and numbered sizes #000 to #7. Usable inside size is about an inch shorter than the outer size.
- Padding: 3/16 in air-bubble lining, self-seal strip.
- Finishes: kraft paper (#000 to #7), white poly (#000 to #5), metallic and recyclable paper on request.
- Pricing: plain stock starting from $0.12 per mailer (4x6); larger sizes start higher, up to starting from $0.48 per mailer (#7). Minimum order (MOQ) 250 mailers; printing, material and smaller quantities change the figure. Emailed quotes are firm.
- Printing: 1, 2 or full color, both sides optional, digital proof before production, minimum order (MOQ) 250 mailers.
- Ordering: by the case (100-500 mailers depending on size) or pallet (10,000+), mixed sizes allowed, scheduled releases for pallet programs.
- Shipping: free to any US address, any quantity; dispatched within 4-6 business days, then 2-3 business days in transit (https://shopbubblemailers.com/shipping-policy/). Returns: made to order, no change-of-mind returns; damage, defects, shortfalls and orders that do not match the approved proof, reported within 14 days of delivery, are replaced or refunded within 10 business days (https://shopbubblemailers.com/refund_returns/).
